<thought>The spectrum shows a clear M+2 peak (~24% of the base peak) which matches the characteristic isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). No other element shows a distinctive isotopic pattern (e.g., bromine’s ~1:1 M+2, sulfur’s low‑intensity M+2). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
